observation: Final raw226 candidate fails actual anatomy. Side339 retains a rounded unsupported mass with a horizontal underside. Front339 forms a broad flanged/bib-like lower chest. Opposite oblique339 exposes a triangular shoulder/root skin web and a dark hollow beneath its overhang. The whole333 view supplies context but cannot cancel those close-view defects. Neutral raw283 remains an experimental control, not a final accepted anatomy target. Primary matrices, existing curves, neutral/boundary/exterior/true-distal surfaces are preserved; eight coupled upper-elbow points move3.11mm. Those technical successes do not pass the anatomical result.
